etymology.historical_story: Monica belongs to an international naming tradition rather than Malay affixation. A famous early bearer was Augustine's mother; scholarship notes the spelling Monnica in manuscripts of his Confessions. The name's origin remains uncertain. Its historical associations should therefore be distinguished from a securely established literal meaning. [Cambridge: Monnica](https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/new-blackfriars/article/abs/monnica-my-mother/25412EAC65182CD26ED29CF2C3F0940A) [Infopédia: Mónica](https://www.infopedia.pt/dicionarios/antroponimia/M%C3%B3nica)
